whyItMatters: sha1.convert computes SHA-1 in dart, whose collisions defeat security reliance on the digest.
actions: Replace sha1.convert with sha256.convert wherever the digest protects signatures or untrusted data.
For remaining compatibility uses, add a comment stating SHA-1 is intentional.
Re-run the scan and confirm every remaining hit carries that justification.
verification: Rescan shows no unjustified sha1.convert, and security digests verify under the replacement.
